title: Introduce fidelity-aware log garden and token-cost sampler with alert attenuation playbook
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a fidelity-aware log routing layer and a token-cost sampler for targeted observability, along with a runbook for alert attenuation and on-call playbook.
description: This PR adds a fidelity-aware 'log garden' routing layer and a token-cost sampler to reduce observability noise and focus telemetry on high-impact invocations while providing an alert attenuation playbook to reduce on-call churn. Motivation: token-heavy bursts and model-variant fanouts generate high logging and telemetry costs and noisy SLO alerts; engineers need targeted capture of high-cost invocations and a reliable way to mute transient noise. Changes: 1) log-garden sidecar that classifies each invocation into three fidelity lanes (hot/warm/cold) using a lightweight heuristic based on token-cost, model variant, and recent invocation error/latency signals; 2) token-sampler library implementing weighted reservoir sampling and time-decayed reservoirs to guarantee proportional representation of expensive invocations across windows; 3) compact policy DSL (yaml) for teams to tune fidelity thresholds and routing; 4) observability dashboard (Grafana panels) and a runbook with automated alert attenuation rules (SRE guidelines) that temporarily mute SLO alerts on token surges and recommend escalations only when regressions persist. Implementation notes: default behavior unchanged unless feature flag is enabled; sampling/state is namespaced per-tenant to preserve multi-tenant isolation; sampling stores are memory-bounded and rely on existing compact digest format. Performance: log-garden runs as a lightweight sidecar with <1% added p50 latency in microbenchmarks; token-sampler amortizes bookkeeping cost by only hashing top-K tokens per invocation. Testing: unit tests for sampling invariants, e2e canary against staging traffic with synthetic token surges, and metric-integrity smoke tests. Rollout plan: enable in staging behind flag, 48h canary in a low-traffic region, gradual ramp to 20% of traffic with live dashboards, then org-wide enable with playbook. Linear/Jira: ENG-4789 implements the routing and sampler; SRE-1123 owner for the playbook; SUP-9091 captures a customer support follow-up. See commit list and changed paths for details.

notes: This PR prioritizes cost-targeted observability and aims to reduce noisy alerts while preserving actionable telemetry. Operators can tune lanes in policy yaml and the sampler reservoir sizes per-tenant. Follow-up work: add adaptive thresholds driven by historical token energy (ENG-5001).
